t.why: Extremely vulnerable to rising seas. It switched recognition from Taiwan to China in 2019.
t.rel: An island country scattered widely along the equator. It cooperates with Australia and New Zealand on labor mobility and is a Pacific Islands Forum member.
t.know: One of the first countries in the world to welcome the new year.
t.etext: A Pacific island country with vast seas: selling tuna fishing rights to foreign fleets provides most of its revenue. It is extremely vulnerable to rising seas.
